requirements.text: Produce a brownfield implementation plan for orchestrator spin-up reuse and observability that resolves the remaining live Docker image warm-path issue and extends cache visibility into persisted and aggregate reporting.

Produce a brownfield refactor plan for the highest-value code-quality hotspots: typed request/option objects for CLI-heavy entrypoints, decomposition of `_promotion_guard`, consolidation of shared provider-adapter behavior, and targeted tests for low-coverage operational modules.
Exclude scenario files from implementation scope entirely, including starter folders; the plan must not schedule code or structural changes under `scenarios/**`.

Add and enforce repo guidance that `scenarios/**/starter/**` is excluded from analysis and code-quality checks because those files are representative delivery-scenario artifacts rather than canonical shared product code.

tasks.action: Read the Context Pack and freeze scope before implementation starts.
Enforce the starter-folder analysis exclusion in the relevant analyzer/quality configuration without touching scenario files.

tasks.expectedOutput: no `scenarios/` paths in the implementation diff
tasks.action: Fail the implementation if any planned change spills into `scenarios/**`.
Do not start hotspot refactors until the orchestrator warm-path and exclusion-enforcement track is complete and verified.

tasks.expectedOutput: persisted fast-image artifact path implemented with cache-state traceability
tasks.action: Replace daemon-local fast-image dependence with a generic persisted reusable artifact flow and preserve cache-state traceability.

tasks.expectedOutput: aggregate reporting exposes cache-state and invalidation data
tasks.action: Surface orchestrator cache metadata beyond raw run artifacts.

tasks.expectedOutput: repeated warm-path smoke succeeds with durable image/cache behavior
tasks.action: Run the mandatory repeated orchestrator smoke verification for Checkpoint A.

tasks.expectedOutput: Checkpoint A changes remain green under the full repo gate
tasks.action: Run the full quality gate at the end of Checkpoint A before allowing hotspot refactors.

tasks.expectedOutput: request/result assembly broken into typed helpers
tasks.action: Refactor the broad CLI and summary seams into smaller typed request/result objects.

tasks.expectedOutput: guard logic split into independently testable evaluators
shared adapter behavior centralized with provider-specific rules preserved
tasks.action: Consolidate provider-adapter duplication through reusable base helpers/contracts.

tasks.command: uv run --project orchestrator python -m pytest orchestrator/tests -q
tasks.expectedOutput: targeted low-coverage seams have deterministic tests
tasks.action: Add or extend tests around the operational modules named in the quality report.

tasks.expectedOutput: repo gate passes with both checkpoints complete
tasks.action: Run the full quality gate at the end of Checkpoint B.

verificationScenarios.given: Given an unchanged orchestrator smoke setup and a warm persisted fast-image artifact state
verificationScenarios.when: When `make orchestrator-smoke` is run twice with identical inputs
verificationScenarios.then: Then the second invocation reloads or reuses the persisted fast-image artifact path without a fresh image build

verificationScenarios.given: Given Checkpoint A changes are complete
verificationScenarios.when: When `make quality` is run before hotspot refactors begin
verificationScenarios.then: Then orchestrator warm-path/reporting and exclusion enforcement are green in isolation

verificationScenarios.given: Given the refactored CLI/request seams and adapter helpers
verificationScenarios.when: When `make quality` is run at the end of the full implementation
verificationScenarios.then: Then public command behavior and repo gates remain green

verificationScenarios.when: When the implementation diff is inspected
verificationScenarios.then: Then no path under `scenarios/**` is modified

verificationScenarios.given: Given low-coverage operational modules named in the quality report
verificationScenarios.when: When targeted pytest coverage is executed
verificationScenarios.then: Then new deterministic tests protect the touched operational seams
verificationScenarios.evidenceCommand: uv run --project orchestrator python -m pytest orchestrator/tests -q
